expectations.ownedSources: Owned colored lands reduce demand for added basics; equal total sources produce a balanced base for equal demand.
expectations.splashTempo: Calling the same physical mana configuration a splash cannot improve its objective by granting extra draw steps for free.
expectations.responsive: V4 decisions and full replay run outside the UI thread; pending actions are guarded, errors preserve the prior save.
expectations.compatibility: V2/V3 replays unchanged; previous v4 algorithm snapshots are preserved before replacement.

scope: Safe production release with v3 default and v4 explicitly experimental. Promotion requires independent positive evidence and complete declared capabilities; no fabricated annotations or WR.
